assignments.title: Red-Black Tree & AVL Tree Implementation in C++
assignments.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
assignments.description: Implement self-balancing Binary Search Trees including AVL Tree rotations (LL, RR, LR, RL) and Red-Black Tree recoloring & rotations. Include time complexity benchmarks.

assignments.title: Producer-Consumer Problem using POSIX Semaphores
assignments.subject: Operating Systems
assignments.description: Develop a multi-threaded C program simulating the classic bounded-buffer producer-consumer problem. Use pthread mutex and sem_t to ensure deadlock-free synchronization.

assignments.title: Socket Programming: Multi-Client Chat Server in Python
assignments.subject: Computer Networks
assignments.description: Write a multi-threaded TCP server in Python that can accept multiple concurrent clients, broadcast messages, handle client disconnects gracefully, and implement private messaging.
assignments.submissionType: Python scripts (.py) with Wireshark packet capture

assignments.title: Few-Shot Chain-of-Thought Benchmark Evaluation
assignments.subject: Prompt Engineering & Generative AI
assignments.description: Design structured zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompts for mathematical and logical reasoning using Google Gemini API. Compare accuracy and hallucination rates across 20 test questions.

assignments.title: Graph Coloring Theorems & Recurrence Relation Proofs
assignments.subject: Discrete Mathematics
assignments.description: Prove four-color theorem basics, solve linear homogeneous recurrence relations with constant coefficients, and demonstrate bipartite graph testing using DFS.

assignments.title: Subnetting and CIDR Routing Table Configuration
assignments.subject: Computer Networks
assignments.description: Calculate subnets, broadcast addresses, and valid host ranges for a classless IPv4 enterprise network with VLSM. Submit Cisco Packet Tracer topology file.
